title: docs(adr): the 19 stale Proposed records (status date before 2026-07-26) are ruled by the maintainer in four batches of five — carrier for the rulings and the status-line PRs
body:
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed — ruling A on #26076 (comment 6417460375, batch #398 item 3, maintainer 「其他同意」): *"The 19 Proposed records older than 2026-07-26 are not relabelled by the PR: the PR lists them with an implementation reading each, and this seat presents them to the maintainer in ruling batches of five."* PR #26503 (merged 2026-10-27T06:55Z) carries that list. Filed by the director seat (`session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). ⛔ Not a claim. Reader: the director seat (presents and records the rulings here) and, per batch, whoever opens the status-line PR (`docs/adr/**`, Tier H, lands by the maintainer's approval; authoring is open to every seat). Dedupe: #26076 (closed, the ruling), PR #26503 (the list) — this card is their carrier, not a duplicate; 600 newest issues grepped `stale Proposed|Proposed ADR` → 0 other.

## 维护者速读

#26076 你裁了 A：索引生成、拼写统一、重号并列，19 份状态还写着 Proposed、日期早于 2026-07-26 的记录**不由席位改标，由你逐份裁**。PR #26503 已落地并给每份附了实现读数。本卡收四批裁决（每批五份），每批裁完由席位开一个只改状态行的 `docs/adr/**` PR，你批准落地。每份只有四种结局：**Accepted**（已实现或按实现程度接受，状态行写明待办）、**Deferred**（留作提案，不排期）、**Withdrawn**（不做了）、**Superseded**（被哪份取代）。

## The 19, in the order PR #26503 lists them

Batch 1: ADR-0010 (metadata-protection-model) · ADR-0019 (app-as-consumer-unit) · ADR-0022 · ADR-0026 · ADR-0027.
Batch 2: ADR-0038 · ADR-0046 · ADR-0050 · ADR-0051 · ADR-0052.
Batch 3: ADR-0063 · ADR-0064 · ADR-0071 · ADR-0072 · ADR-0073.
Batch 4: ADR-0077 · ADR-0080 · ADR-0096 · ADR-0025.

## Done-when

- Four ruling comments on this card (one per batch, `Ruling:` first line, letters per record, the maintainer's words verbatim).
- Four status-line PRs merged (or fewer, if the maintainer rules several batches before a PR is cut); `node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check` green after each.
- `docs/adr/README.md` shows no `Proposed` row with a status date before 2026-07-26.

**Size:** XS per PR (status lines only; a `Superseded` ruling adds the cross-reference line the index reads). **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.

## Related

#26076 (ruling A); PR #26503 (index + the 19 readings); AGENTS.md Prime Directive 13 (numbers never reassigned) and 14 (Tier H).
